description: This bar chart, titled "Before Generation, Align it! A Novel and Effective Strategy for Mitigating Hallucinations in Text-to-SQL Generation," illustrates the execution performance of two SQL generation approaches, NatSQL and TA-SQL, across three difficulty categories—"Simple," "Moderate," and "Challenging"—along with a "Total" summary. The horizontal axis displays these four categories in the order presented: Simple, Moderate, Challenging, and Total. The vertical axis is labeled "Execution Time" and uses a linear scale ranging from 20 to 60, with tick marks at intervals of 10. For each category, two grouped bars are shown: a light blue bar representing NatSQL and a darker blue bar representing TA-SQL, as indicated by the legend. The specific execution times are labeled on top of each bar: for "Simple," NatSQL is 60.21 and TA-SQL is 63.14; for "Moderate," NatSQL is 39.64 and TA-SQL is 48.60; for "Challenging," NatSQL is 32.32 and TA-SQL is 36.11; and for "Total," NatSQL is 51.35 and TA-SQL is 56.19. The bars are arranged in descending order of their total execution time, with "Simple" having the highest values and "Challenging" the lowest. No bars are visually emphasized through shading, bolding, or outlining.
